name: Surplus Intelligence
description: A from-chat usage dashboard for your Surplus Intelligence inference account: prices, models, your API key, USDC balance/allowance, and savings (no wallet needed). You buy inference by using your key as an OpenAI-compatible provider at <base>/api/inference/v1 in your own client — this plugin is the dashboard around that, not an inference client. Run /inference_provider for the setup. Seller commands are not yet implemented.
author: ProlowN <robin334@protonmail.com>
setupHints: Set INFERENCE_API_URL to the Surplus Intelligence API host you intend to use (https required, http only for localhost). Defaults to https://www.surplusintelligence.ai.
Browsing the market (/inference_prices, /inference_models) needs no credentials.

Create an inf_ key in the dashboard (https://www.surplusintelligence.ai/buy), add USDC to your wallet, and approve spend there. Set the key as INFERENCE_API_KEY so the dashboard commands can read your account.

To actually buy inference, use that key as an OpenAI-compatible provider at <INFERENCE_API_URL>/api/inference/v1 in your client (opencode, OpenClaw, Cursor, etc.) — run /inference_provider for the exact setup. This plugin does not send inference itself.
Seller commands are not yet implemented — the dashboard cannot issue a seller API key yet.

INFERENCE_API_KEY.description: Your Surplus Intelligence API key (inf_…) created in the dashboard (SI labels it a "buyer key"). One key, two uses: the provider key your client sends to buy inference, and what this plugin reads your account/usage with.
